anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous convex arc with a smooth curvature along the anterior-dorsal boundary of the head.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered conical extension with a low length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the descending melon slope meets the base of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, bifurcated caudal fluke with acute-tipped lobes and a defined central median notch; visible ventral-lateral skin folds.
